workflow.name: After posting
workflow.description:
Runs once per order, after the parcel is posted. Source: claude/Shipping-Workflow.md (Stages 6, 6b, 7 and 9). Keep the two in step.

## Problems (use when a buyer reports one)

Untracked 2nd Class has no eBay seller protection for item-not-received claims (it needs tracking). Proof of posting protects your dispatch record, not the claim, so put things right quickly: a reprint costs about £2.58. Answer every message within 24 hours.

**Not received**
- Before the estimated date: reply kindly — posted on [date] by Royal Mail 2nd Class; please allow until [estimated date + 3 working days].
- After that: free reprint (next morning's batch) or a refund, buyer's choice. One resend per buyer; a second claim gets a refund. Log: Resent, INR.

**Damaged, faulty or our mistake** (creased, wet, wrong text or design, print fault, peeling or fading)
- Ask for one photo, then offer a free reprint **or** a full refund — buyer's choice.
- Don't ask for it back. If the buyer opens a return anyway, refund without a return (or pay the return label). Never charge return postage for these.
- Faulty after use: eBay's minimum is 30 days; be generous after that.
- Use the photo to fix the cause; for our mistakes, find the stage that missed it on the job sheet.
- Log: Damage + type / Our error + stage / Durability.

**Buyer's typo** (printed as typed)
- Goodwill, once per buyer: the buyer places a new order with the corrected text; send a partial refund on it of everything except postage (£4.09 back on £5.00). Never take payment outside eBay. Log: Goodwill reprint, buyer typo.

**Change of mind**
- Not accepted (personalised item). Decline the return request, citing the exemption.

**Neutral or negative feedback**
- Reply publicly, calmly and briefly, and fix the problem. Once it's fixed, you may ask the buyer once to revise it, within 30 days of the feedback.

**Resend**
- Same order line in make_order.py; new proof only if the text changes; parcel mark ends in R; new label (eBay if it allows a second label on the order, otherwise Click & Drop); log it.

## Weekly check (Mondays, not per order)

**eBay**
- Seller Hub → Performance: defect rate, cases closed without seller resolution, late dispatches. Act on anything rising before the monthly evaluation on the 20th.
- Payments: check payouts (new sellers' funds may be held).
- Listings: top each design and family back up to 3 while sheets allow.
- Follow-ups: send any that came due this week.

**Stock — reorder or reprint when**
- Vinyl and laminate: about 15 sheets left
- C6 envelopes: 20 left (£7 for 50)
- AKAR boxes: 10 left (£10 for 50)
- Sellotape Zero Plastic: when you open the last roll
- Seal stickers: fewer than 6 → print 1 sheet
- Peel markers: fewer than 12 sets → print 1 sheet
- A6 instructions cards: last card used → print 1 sheet
- 250gsm white card: 5 sheets left
- Wrap paper (120gsm): 30 sheets left
- SmithPackaging label sheets: fewer than 20

steps.name: Dispatch check and order log
steps.instructions:
1. Seller Hub → Orders: check the order shows **Dispatched**. If not, mark it dispatched (test SW6 decides whether eBay labels do this automatically). Click & Drop labels: always mark by hand.
2. Buyer messages: none at dispatch (eBay tells the buyer). Message only for a hold, a delay, a split parcel, or a Large Letter swap that changes the delivery estimate.
3. **Image (required) — proof of posting:** a screenshot of the Royal Mail locker's drop-off email for this parcel (date and time readable). Keep the email itself too.
4. WordPress order log — add:
   - Posted (date)
   - Parcel: envelope / AKAR box / split (2 parcels)
   - Packs: 1 / 2 / 3
   - Service: 2nd Class Letter / Large Letter
   - Postage paid, e.g. £0.91
   - Label from: eBay / Click & Drop
   - Box weight (box orders only)
   - Proof: locker email / Certificate of Posting / app postbox proof
   - Parcel mark, e.g. 4417 S
   - Dispatched on eBay ✓
   - Follow-up due: posting date + 7 days
   - Photos: 1 contents · 2 sealed · 3 labelled · proof-of-posting screenshot
5. Keep the proof of posting for at least 3 months, and label receipts with the accounts (HMRC: at least 5 years after the 31 January deadline for that tax year).

tasks.label: Order shows Dispatched on eBay (else marked by hand)
Buyer messaged only if needed (hold, delay, split, Large Letter swap)

steps.photo_label: Screenshot of the locker drop-off email, date and time readable

steps.name: Check feedback left for the buyer
steps.instructions:
- Check that feedback has been left for the buyer (Orders → the order). If not, leave it now: sellers can only leave positive feedback.
- One-off set-up, if not done yet: **Selling preferences → All listings and orders → Automate feedback → Edit**, and choose **after the buyer has paid**. eBay then leaves it for every paid order.
- Why it matters: eBay's own automatic positive feedback for sellers needs tracked, on-time delivery, so untracked 2nd Class orders only get feedback if the buyer leaves it.

tasks.label: Feedback left for the buyer (or left now)

steps.name: Send one follow-up message, about 7 days after posting
steps.instructions:
About 7 days after posting, once the delivery window has passed. Once per order, through eBay messages.

Skip the message if the buyer has already left feedback, or a problem is already open (see Problems in this workflow's description).

> Hi [buyer's first name], your stickers were posted on [posting date] by Royal Mail 2nd Class – I hope they arrived safely. If anything isn't right, just message me and I'll sort it out. If you have a moment, feedback really helps a small new seller. Thanks, [your first name], Doorstep Studio

Never ask for "positive" or "5-star" feedback, and never offer anything in return (discount, freebie, refund).

**Confirming "package arrived":** untracked post can't show delivery. Confirm this step once the message is sent (or skipped) and the buyer hasn't reported a problem by day 7. If they report one later, go to Problems.

Log: follow-up sent (date), and later the buyer's feedback (+ / neutral / − / none).

tasks.label: Buyer hasn't left feedback and no problem is open (else skip the message)
No "positive" or "5-star" wording, no incentive offered
Follow-up date and buyer's feedback logged
